about_the_game:
Ready your guild. Shape your destiny.

Guild Hall Simulator: Prologue gives you an early chance to step into the role of a guild master — build your guild, manage heroes, and guide your hall to legendary fame!

Don't forget to wishlist the full game to continue your journey and build the greatest adventuring guild the world has ever seen.

Guild Management

Design and build your perfect guild hall:

• Place crafting stations, taverns, research labs, and training grounds.

• Optimize your layout to empower your adventurers and boost quest success.

• Unlock adventurers' hidden potential by matching the right hero to the right quest — from humble G rank missions to elite SSS ranked challenges.

Economy Management

Start your journey from zero fame and no gold:

• Set item prices and manage your inventory.

• Grow your guild’s economy carefully — even when pressure rises.

• Balance risk and reward: will you prioritize fame, fortune, or survival?

The Adventure Continues!

This Prologue is just the beginning.
Wishlist Guild Hall Simulator to experience the full game, where your choices matter:

• Rebuild your guild from rubble in an abandoned town.
• Gather materials through mining, farming, and logging.
• Craft rare weapons, forge armor, and brew powerful potions.
• Train weaker adventurers to meet quest requirements.
• Defend your guild and town against monster attacks.
• Automate your operations to run a thriving guild hall — even while adventurers eat, drink, and celebrate!

Will your guild rise as the last beacon of hope - or collapse under the weight of ambition?

The choice is yours, Guild Master.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: i5 3550 / RYZEN 5 2500X
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD R9 270X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: i5 7600K / Ryzen 5 2600x
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 480
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Build your guild. Shape your story. In Guild Hall Simulator, you don't slay dragons — you send others to do it. Manage gold, assign quests, upgrade your hall, and wrangle rowdy adventurers who drink too much. Will your guild rise to fame...or collapse under a mountain of paperwork (and slimes)?
